svg.title: Optimal cluster-count confusion matrices: three clustering validity indices
svg.desc: Comparisons across eight archived benchmark datasets. DB on hardened fuzzy C-means correctly selects five of eight cluster counts, DB on K-means four of eight, and SDB on fuzzy C-means three of eight. Each matrix has true number of clusters on rows and selected number on columns.
svg.text: Which validity index finds the true number of clusters?
Confusion matrices from eight 2018 ground-truth datasets · Python reimplementation · 3 seeds per K
Rows = real K · Columns = K minimizing the mean score over 3 seeds (candidate K = 2–10)
Rows = real K · Columns = K minimizing the mean score over 3 seeds (candidate K = 2–10)
Rows = real K · Columns = K minimizing the mean score over 3 seeds (candidate K = 2–10)
Each dataset contributes once per criterion. This is not a sample-label confusion matrix or a test of statistical superiority.
